neighbours.label: an approximating word before a quantity ('nearly', 'almost', 'about', 'approximately', German 'ca.'); the - pole is the upper-bound side ('up to', 'upwards of')
fire: The trip took nearly six hours because of the snow.
The museum owns almost 3,000 paintings from the region.
Our school has about 400 students and 30 teachers.
The castle on the hill is approximately 800 years old.
She has worked at the bank for nearly two decades.
The tickets sold out in almost twenty minutes.
The lake is about 12 km long and very deep.
Die Wohnung liegt ca. 2 km vom Bahnhof entfernt.
quiet: The trip took six hours because of the snow.
The museum owns 3,000 paintings from the region.
Our school has 400 students and 30 teachers.
The castle on the hill is exactly 800 years old.
She has worked at the bank for two decades now.
The tickets sold out in twenty minutes.
The lake is 12 km long and very deep.
Die Wohnung liegt 2 km vom Bahnhof entfernt.

notes: Probe: nearly 0.48, Almost 0.47, about 0.32, approximately 0.27, circa 0.07; 'up to' 0.04, 'upwards of' 0.01, exact number 0.03. Quiet items are the same sentences with exact numbers (no 'than', which the card also lists).
